reuse.why: Builds a proper shared category selection, but detects the #fixed tag with its own regex instead of the existing tag parsing in shared/tags.ts (extractTagsFromText), with different delimiter/escape semantics, and parses goal_def by hand.

duplication.why: All month-wide actions share isSkippedByMonthWideAction/getMonthWideCategories, but the category+group+notes join is written twice (getBudgetData and getMonthWideCategories) and the income/tracking check is still repeated in each action including the new one.

placement.why: The selection rule and the new action live in server/budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions, and the method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Changes are limited to the month-wide actions, the new method, a test and release notes.

maintainability.why: One predicate with a named parameter for the hidden rule is easy to own; the hand-rolled tag regex and duplicated SQL join are the weak spots.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts hasFixedTag uses its own /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/ regex instead of the tag parser in shared/tags.ts.

abstraction_drift.where: isSkippedByMonthWideAction/getMonthWideCategories gained the includeHiddenCategories parameter (the requested variation); every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth via getBudgetData rows and the new setLastMonthSpending, goes through the predicate.
